links.outcome: Alert burden on healthcare professionals from high-volume remote monitoring alerts
links.effect: Case group generated far more alerts (61,827 vs. 1825; p < 0.05) but without overloading healthcare professionals thanks to automatic AI alert management.
links.quote: The case group received a more exhaustive follow-up, with a higher number of alerts (61,827 vs. 1825; p < 0.05) but without overloading healthcare professionals thanks to automatic alert management through artificial intelligence.

unlisted_practices: Remote patient monitoring with wearables and automatic AI alert generation for COVID-19 home isolation
Identifying baseline patient factors (asthma, corticosteroid use) associated with severe alerts

screen.reason: Prospective randomized controlled trial testing the clinical deployment of an AI-based clinical decision support and alert management system for remote patient monitoring of COVID-19 patients.
